summary: Sabesp filed a 6-K disclosing execution of a Protocol and Justification to merge with EMAE by absorbing EMAE's shares. The transaction follows an April 24, 2026 material fact. Terms are set for shareholder votes at EGMs on July 30, 2026. Exchange ratio and precise pricing are not specified in the excerpt; it is a stock-for-stock merger of two Brazilian publicly-held companies (both Category A issuers on B3). Regulatory references include CVM Resolution 78. Watch for shareholder approval and potential appraisal rights. The deal appears friendly, with boards calling meetings and recommending approval.
